project.name: BudgetBasics
project.description: An educational budgeting website designed to help students learn budgeting, saving, spending, and basic money management.

steps: Download or extract the BudgetBasics project folder.
Open the project folder in a code editor.
Make sure all JSON files are inside the data folder.
Open index.html in a web browser.
For best results, run the project using a local development server.

projectAssumptions: The website is intended for educational purposes.
No user account or login system is required.
Calculator results are generated on the client side.
Expense Planner data is temporary and does not require server storage.
Feedback and contact forms use client-side validation only.
Predefined content is stored in JSON files.
Financial examples are educational estimates and not professional financial advice.
importantNotes: Do not store sensitive personal information.
All calculator inputs should be validated before calculations.
Negative and invalid numeric values should be rejected where applicable.
The website should work on desktop, tablet, and mobile devices.
Images should include appropriate alternative text.
The AI chatbot should provide a safe fallback for questions outside budgeting topics.
